issue_context.title: network: tc: htb: not all qdisc options is supported
issue_context.body:
Currently we can't setup: mtu, burst, cburst and r2q.

If htb class is 100Mbit (or more) and r2q in default value, in dmesg you will get:

```shell
[Tue Mar 24 17:11:07 2020] HTB: quantum of class 10001 is big. Consider r2q change.
```

review_comments: We should handle the `log_oom()` at ` qdisc = new(QDisc, 1);` as it's not a library. Here we should handle error `r < 0`. Or may be just OK with it.
I will consider your point later in other PR. Thanks.
